visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, reddish-brown hair wearing a beige V-neck knitted sweater is seated on a brown couch. She speaks directly to the camera with animated facial expressions. In the background, a simple white wall is visible, and digital overlays showing various AI-generated anime characters appear around her. (2) The creator holds a smartphone in her hands, displaying a mobile application interface with a text prompt. The camera zooms in slightly as she gestures toward the screen. Graphic text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear at the top and bottom of the frame to provide context. (3) The visual transitions to various AI-generated images of pianos, ranging from broken, low-cost versions to highly ornate, golden, multi-tiered instruments. The creator is visible in a small inset or at the bottom, reacting with humor and pointing out technical inaccuracies in the AI's depiction of piano keys. (4) A top-down close-up shot of a white piano keyboard appears, focusing on the black and white keys. Red numbered graphics (2 and 3) are superimposed over the black keys to explain their grouped arrangement. The creator reappears on screen to summarize her findings with a comedic meme mask overlay appearing briefly for emphasis.
